content.short: Gridlock delivers secure, user-friendly crypto storage with a 3-of-5 threshold for true self-custody, seed-phrase removal, and a continuously monitored, self-repairing network.
content.description: Gridlock redefines crypto storage with an easy, quick setup and robust security. Its 3-of-5 threshold enables true self-custody, free from third-party control and seed phrases. The setup is fast and intentionally removes single points of failure, while the network remains continuously monitored and self-repairing to keep assets safe. Security is distributed across a grid of devices, which lock crypto and provide effortless, worry-free ownership.
content.meta: Gridlock redefines crypto storage with its user-friendly setup and unparalleled security. Discover Gridlock and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
